Empowering businesses and rewarding travelers

Earn more as an AAdvantage® miles Business™ member

The AAdvantage Business™ program rewards companies with AAdvantage® miles on all business travel booked at aa.com, while also rewarding individual employees with Loyalty Points.

Streamline travel management

Your AAdvantage Business™ program membership also includes a suite of tools to simplify booking, reporting and travel management. For complete details about the AAdvantage Business™ program, visit aa.com/aadvantagebusiness

Two ways to earn and enjoy

AAdvantage® miles

Earn AAdvantage® miles for your business on eligible purchases. Use your AAdvantage® miles for flights to nearly 1,100 destinations worldwide on American Airlines, oneworld® and partner airlines. Miles can also be redeemed for seat upgrades, car rentals, hotel stays, vacation packages and more.

Loyalty Points

Each cardmember (primary and employees) earns 1 Loyalty Point for every $1 spent on their business card purchases. Status members have access to even more exclusive perks designed to enhance their travel experience. Enjoy complimentary premium cabin upgrades, complimentary Main Cabin Extra and Preferred Seats, and same-day standby priority. Benefits vary by status tier.

No foreign transaction fees1

Keep your business expenses and budget on track when you shop overseas.

American Airlines Companion Certificate

Earn an American Airlines Companion Certificate for qualifying domestic travel after you spend $30,000 in purchases each cardmembership year and cardmembership is renewed. Redeeming the certificate is $99 for the ticketing fee plus taxes and fees.2

No blackout dates

Travel when you want. Plan your travel freely with no blackout dates when booking with miles.

Add Authorized Users

Receive employee cards at no additional cost1 and earn more miles for your business when employees use their card for purchases.2

No limit on the amount of miles you can earn

There is no maximum number of American Airlines AAdvantage® miles that you can accumulate with your card.

Citi® Quick Lock
Misplaced your card? Use Citi Quick Lock in the Citi Mobile® App or at citi.com to instantly block new charges while allowing recurring transactions to continue without disruption.
24-hour fraud protection
Citi will alert you if we see unusual activity on your account.
Mastercard® ID Theft Protection
The ID Theft Protection program offered by Mastercard® helps eliminate the worry of identity theft by monitoring the information you choose to protect and alerting you if suspicious activity is found. It takes just a few minutes to enroll for free, and as soon as you do, your monitoring begins. Visit mastercardidps.idprotectiononline.com to learn more.
Chip-based card technology
Chip card technology keeps the same card number but provides you with security and global acceptance.
Automatic account alerts
Stay updated on balance, payments and credit limits via email or text.
Choose your payment due date
Choose to pay your bill on any available due date in the beginning, middle or end of the month. Enjoy the flexibility of paying your full balance or just the minimum payment due each month.
Paperless statements and e-communications
Reduce clutter and get your statements and most legal notices online instead of in the mail.
Add Authorized Users
Receive employee cards at no additional cost and earn more miles for your business when employees use their card for purchases.1
24/7 Customer Service
Questions about your Citi® card account? Just call the number on the back of your credit card. Just say "representative" to access fast, live help from a friendly Customer Service representative ready to help with virtually every aspect of your cardmembership (including technical assistance) — 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
Contactless pay
Shop safely with a contactless, chip-enabled card. Just tap your card on the payment reader and go in seconds.
Digital wallets
Digital wallets let you shop with confidence in millions of places online, within apps and in stores. With digital wallets, you can speed through checkout and continue to enjoy all the great benefits that come with your card. Learn how to get started and how digital wallets can help protect your card information at citi.com/digitalservices.
Citi Entertainment®
Citi Entertainment® is an entertainment access program available to eligible Citi® credit card and Citibank® Debit Card customers. Citi cardmembers get special access to purchase tickets to thousands of events, including presale tickets and exclusive experiences to the year's most anticipated concerts, sporting events, arts and culture experiences. To learn more, visit citientertainment.com.
Citi® Flex Pay
Buy now, pay later with Citi® Flex Pay. Pay over time in fixed monthly payments and continue to earn points on purchases. Available on eligible purchases of $75 or more.2
No foreign transaction fees1
Stretch your business budget further on overseas purchases.1

Miles earned from the primary cardholder and Authorized Users post to the company’s AAdvantage Business™ account. Each cardmember (primary and employee) earn Loyalty Points on his or her card purchases. Loyalty Points earned by the primary cardmember post to the primary cardholder’s AAdvantage® account. Loyalty Points earned by the employee post to the employee's AAdvantage® account.

Learn more about the AAdvantage Business™ program: aa.com/aadvantagebusiness

An AAdvantage Business™ account is created with new Citi® / AAdvantage Business™ Mastercard® accounts. As long as there isn't an existing business account, it will be created upon application approval. AAdvantage® bonus miles earned from a new account bonus will post to the company’s AAdvantage Business™ account.

Learn more about the AAdvantage Business™ program: aa.com/aadvantagebusiness

Yes, you can earn Loyalty Points toward status with the Citi® / AAdvantage Business™ Mastercard®. Each cardmember (primary and employees) earns 1 Loyalty Point toward status for every $1 spent on their card.2

For an Authorized User to get this benefit, they must be one of the 4 companions traveling on the primary cardholder’s reservation.2

  • Eligible American Airlines purchases
  • Telecommunications merchants
  • Car rental merchants
  • Cable and satellite providers
  • Gas stations

Plus, your business earns 1 AAdvantage® mile per dollar spent on other purchases with your card.

Cardmembers also earn 1 additional Loyalty Point per $1 spent on purchases with their card. This is on top of Loyalty Points earned as an AAdvantage® member and within the AAdvantage Business™ program.
